## Simplify `verify_tag` with iterator combinators

The manual index loop in `verify_tag` predates our MSRV bump and is the last place in `mac.rs` still using raw indexing. This rewrites it with `zip` + `all`, which is the idiomatic way to check element-wise equality and lets the compiler elide the bounds checks.

Behaviour is unchanged: `verify_tag` returns `true` iff all 32 bytes match. Existing tests (`verify_tag_accepts_equal`, `verify_tag_rejects_first_byte`, `verify_tag_rejects_last_byte`) pass unchanged.

Clippy is now clean on this file (`clippy::needless_range_loop`).
